parole.significato: the time between sunrise and noon
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish قوشلق (kuşluk), from Old Anatolian Turkish قوشلق (quşluq), from Proto-Oghuz قُشْلُقْ (qušluq). By surface analysis, kuş + -luk. Compare Gagauz kuşluk, Azerbaijani quşluq, Turkmen guşluk, Salar goşluq
Inherited from Ottoman Turkish تصارلامق (tasarlamak), of disputed origin. Nişanyan suggests it is from Proto-Oghuz *tasbar- + -la, the former being from *tas + *bar-.
Coined during the language reform. Derived from Proto-Oghuz *tasbar- + -ı, alternatively from tasar + -ı.

parole.significato: to pretend to be, to present oneself as

parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish اوزرلك (üzerlik), from Early Old Oghuz يوز ارلك (yü:z erlik), ultimately from Proto-Oghuz *yüzerlik (“harmal; ruta montana”). Cognate with Azerbaijani üzərlik and Turkmen ýüzärlik.
